basis: Heart and skeletal defects define syndrome; developmental delay 2/6 and recurrent pneumothoraces 2/6; dental crowding 2/6 omitted by cap.
Mitochondrial neurodevelopmental disorder with movement abnormalities and frequent lactic acidosis; isolated ocular and platelet findings do not establish common involvement.
Inherited amyloid disorder with nerve deposition 4/4; GI dysfunction 3/3 and cardiac amyloidosis 1/1; hepatic deposits lack documented functional impairment.
Intellectual disability and seizures define the disorder; conductive hearing impairment reported in 2/2 assessed patients, although the denominator is small.
Intellectual disability and Hirschsprung disease define this syndrome; cardiac malformations occur in 30-79%. Incontinence alone does not establish urinary tract damage.
GI dysmotility 2/2 and reflux 4/4; urinary tract anomalies include reflux 2/2 and horseshoe kidney 1/3; bicuspid valve 2/3. Scoliosis 2/2 omitted by cap; small denominators.
Inherited erythrocytosis directly affects red blood cells; no common additional organ damage is established.
Mediastinum is not a specified axis. This mixed-site umbrella does not establish lung, airway, heart, nerve or blood-organ origin across most subtypes.
Isolated inherited platelet disorder characterized by large platelets and thrombocytopenia.
Isolated MYH6-related dilated cardiomyopathy directly damages myocardial function.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss, reported in 16/16 patients.
Tumour arises in eyelid epidermis; skin and eyelids are explicitly covered by the dermatologic and ocular axes.
Inflammation of stomach and duodenum; an infectious or immune-mediated cause is not intrinsic to this umbrella concept.
The represented subtypes involve multiple intestinal or gastric polyps; subsequent cancer risk does not add another organ.
VCL-related hypertrophic cardiomyopathy; myocardial hypertrophy, fibrosis and outflow obstruction affect the cardiovascular axis.
Fatty-acid oxidation defect with defining skeletal myopathy and frequent muscle-fibre atrophy; renal insufficiency 5/28 is below 30%.
Enlargement of ectopic thyroid tissue defines the disease; tongue location does not establish oral tissue damage. Airway obstruction is not established as common.
Dental, skeletal and motor abnormalities define SOFM; hypothyroidism and impaired GH response each 2/3. Ocular and hearing abnormalities each 1/3 omitted by cap.
Inappropriate ADH secretion produces disordered water and sodium balance; underlying tumour location and transient neurologic symptoms do not add axes.
TBX20-related congenital atrial septal defect; associated aortic abnormalities remain within the cardiovascular axis.
Isolated congenital finger angulation caused by abnormal phalangeal shape, without associated systemic manifestations.
Inherited deficiency of parathyroid function; autoimmune and syndromic manifestations are not shared across this umbrella.
Defining congenital nail hypo/aplasia and distal phalangeal hypo/aplasia directly affect nails and bones.
Benign adipose neoplasm arising in the oesophagus; aspiration-related respiratory infections are separate complications without established frequency above 30%.
Generalized skin and oral mucosal keratoacanthomas define the disease; ectropion causes eyelid dysfunction in 30-79%. Corneal and conjunctival disease occurs in under 30%.
